name.es-ES: Epistolario (edición crítica de Sala Balust): otras cartas
name.en-US: Letters (Sala Balust's critical edition): further letters
name.pt-BR: Epistolário (edição crítica de Sala Balust): outras cartas

description.es-ES: Cartas de san Juan de Ávila de la edición crítica de Luis Sala Balust (BAC, 1952) que no están en el libro «Epistolario espiritual» (las cien cartas del Apostolado Mariano): a predicadores, señores, señoras, doncellas, religiosas y discípulos. Cada carta lleva su número en la edición de Sala Balust, con los epígrafes de contenido del editor; el texto es el del siglo XVI con sus lecciones críticas, sin el aparato de variantes ni las notas.
description.en-US: Letters of St. John of Ávila from Luis Sala Balust's critical edition (BAC, 1952) that are not in the book «Epistolario espiritual» (the hundred letters of the Apostolado Mariano edition): to preachers, noblemen, ladies, maidens, religious and disciples. Each letter keeps its Sala Balust number and the editor's one-line summary; the text is the sixteenth-century critical text, without the variants apparatus or the notes.
description.pt-BR: Cartas de São João de Ávila da edição crítica de Luis Sala Balust (BAC, 1952) que não estão no livro «Epistolário espiritual».

sources.edition: Obras completas del B. Mtro. Juan de Ávila, edición crítica de Luis Sala Balust, vol. I (Epistolario, pp. 257 ff.), Madrid: Editorial Católica (BAC 111), 1952; archive.org scan, OCR.
sources.description: The letters of the critical edition that the Apostolado book lacks, located in the OCR by their headings and source lines and told apart from the 100 Apostolado letters by comparing their opening words. Letter numbers are Sala Balust's; letters 20 and 85 are printed in several parts [1], [2], [3]. The line numbers, the variants apparatus, the scripture-reference lines and the editor's footnotes are removed. The headings are the index titles of the edition.
sources.tierEvidence: The letters are Ávila's (public domain); the 1952 scan is freely posted on archive.org.
